change: Version1 computed all four fitting counter banks, then stopped at the first family because the coverage/resource LP was infeasible. Treat infeasibility as a valid reported result for a family; preserve all constraints and policies. No replacement baseline, weaker coverage target or extra action is introduced.
known_before_v2: All primary outcomes and four annex fitting counter banks already exist; the first C3_fixed fitting problem was reported infeasible. No annex weights were selected and no annex extra check banks were replayed. The original check banks remain previously known development data.
cache: Reuse exact version1 fitting counter NPZ/JSON files with source hashes and a cache receipt. Preserve version1 source snapshot, lock and incomplete execution receipt; new output folder coverage-annex-v2.
infeasible_result: If a fitting family is infeasible, report no fitted control for it. Independently attempt its check hindsight envelope, which may also be infeasible. Do not confuse infeasibility of a finite bank under constraints with a theorem of physical impossibility or optimality.
all_other_methods: Unchanged from base plan:326 definitions including frozen targets, same resource and M60 constraints, same objective, fitting and development groups, same exploratory status.
